sources.source_name: Shopify developer changelog: Catalog API list_price
sources.purpose: Check whether compare-at price is present and region-valid before showing a markdown or scoring products
sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no paid API calls
sources.reliability_limits: Documentation only; no merchant product payload or authorized store/catalog access was verified. Optional field may be absent due to merchant settings or buyer region.

learnings.title: Catalog list_price is optional and buyer-context dependent
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog published October 9, 2026 states the Catalog API may return a variant compare-at price as optional list_price and a product list_price_range; list_price is only supplied when merchant mapping, buyer-context price comparison, and regional visibility permit it. The price field is unchanged, and the price object amount is in minor currency units.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_CATALOG_LIST_PRICE_CONTEXT_GATE: In video_shopify product evaluation, use list_price only when provided in the same currency and buyer context as price; amounts are minor units. Treat missing list_price as unknown, not as zero or proof of no discount. Do not infer realized margins or change prices from compare-at values; report applicability and require real product data before any product decision.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next authorized Catalog API read, record a real variant price/list_price/currency/buyer region, show the gate result and applied_learning_ids in the actual product decision report. If no authorized API read is available, mark blocked and do not claim application.
fallback_history: If list_price is absent, use independently verified landed cost and actual price for product evaluation, with markdown unknown.
